scraped.scraped_description: Abstract Wikipedia is a Wikimedia Foundation project to create a language-independent layer of structured knowledge that can be rendered into multiple natural languages, enabling knowledge to be written once and displayed in all languages.

name: Abstract Wikipedia
tagline: A Wikimedia project to create a language-independent layer of structured knowledge that can be rendered into multiple natural languages
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions

policy_outcomes.description: Abstract Wikipedia adopted as part of Wikimedia Foundation's strategic direction to improve multilingual knowledge access, influencing Wikimedia's 2030 strategic priorities around language equity
